messages:
sam: heads-up: deploy-bot flagged ap-northeast canary p95 jump + error uptick. auto-revert in ~3m unless acked.
deploy-bot: ALERT: rollout ap-northeast p95 360ms (+150ms) and 1.9% 5xxs over 2m. Auto-revert scheduled in 3m. Use /deploybot ack to suppress.
sam: don't let it auto-fire if we can validate quickly. Tess, can you grab traces and the canary-slice logs?
tess: on it. initial traces show a small spike on the new text-tokenizer path causing CPU spikes on a subset of pods. Also seeing a queue backlog in one node.
owen: Might be an instance-specific anomaly. Recommend suppress and run a targeted node drain + restart first; rollback only if cluster-wide.
sam: good call. I'll ack suppression and attempt a node restart on the affected canary instances. Command: ```/deploybot ack suppress --thread 1712348901 --by sam --reason "investigate node anomaly" --until 2026-01-12T11:30:00Z```
deploy-bot: CONFIRMED: suppression acked by sam until 2026-01-12T11:30:00Z (sup-2d9f). Monitoring continues.
tess: restarted the two suspicious pods; observing immediate CPU drop and p95 falling from 360ms -> 195ms in ~40s. Error rate down to 0.2%.
idhi: Nice. Do we still want to pin or roll anything back? if it's fixed by restart, maybe just keep an eye.
owen: Let's keep the canary scoped but don't roll back yet. If we see recurrence within 10m, escalate to manual rollback to v5.4.1 in ap-northeast.
sam: agree. Owner: tess. I'll leave suppression until we clear the 10m window. Tess, confirm final state after 10m.
tess: will monitor. If it stays stable, I'll expire suppression early and post a short blurb to release-notes: "ap-northeast canary briefly degraded due to pod-level tokenizer CPU spike; node restart mitigated; no rollback needed."
sam: thanks team. Owen, file a follow-up to add a healthcheck for tokenizer CPU in canary baseline so deploy-bot thresholds consider it.
owen: filing ticket now and will add runbook snippet for node-restart before rolling back.
sam: closing thread for now. If anything else fires, ping here. :thumbsup:
